decisions.reason: The formwork profile system sits close to the firm's core formwork know-how, has several models and its own web page, so the firm can read early results and refine it internally.
Automated concrete distribution builds on the firm's automation and engineering expertise and fits its strategic push toward automation, so in-house R&D can absorb early feedback and improve it.
The shuttering magnet line extends the firm's established magnetic formwork knowledge and offers several models, so it is easy to assimilate and adjust despite only a web mention.
Magnetic formwork strips are a core-adjacent product line with a dedicated page, and the firm's existing knowledge lets it interpret customer results well.
This magnetic formwork component is closely related to existing products and shown on its own page, so it is well supported by the firm's knowledge base.
Although it is only mentioned on the website, this component closely matches the firm's formwork competence, and the low cost of keeping it within the system offer favours retention.
